title: Miriam's Song
reflectionQuestion: Miriam was so thankful that she grabbed a tambourine and danced and sang. When something wonderful happens, what is a way you like to show God how happy and thankful you are?

scriptureKeyVerse.text: Miriam answered them, “Sing to Yahweh, for he has triumphed gloriously. He has thrown the horse and his rider into the sea.”
